Context: (b) Free diet.-

- (i) Permission letter should always be issued before the patient visits the private recognized hospitals/diagnostic centres and not after the patient is admitted in the hospital as is happening in various
- CGHS cities.
- (ii)· Following documents should be taken from berreficiary for issuing permission letter:-
- A photocopy of valid CGHS token card. 一
- A request letter from the beneficiary indicating the choice
- of hospital.
- A photocopy of prescription from Government Hospital
